credibility.h2: Advice from a Doctor Who Understands Clinic Ownership.
paras: Opening and running a clinic involves a completely different set of challenges from practising medicine.
As a fellow doctor with experience in clinic ownership and operations, I understand that the journey involves more than clinical knowledge.
My intention is to share practical experience, help you think through important decisions and give you a clearer picture of what lies ahead.
You deserve to make informed decisions before committing your time, money and effort.

book.body: You don't need a business plan. You don't need to have registered a company. You don't even need to have found a clinic location.
book.emphasis: All you need is an idea or a question.

items.a: Yes. Your initial business consultation is free, with no obligation to proceed with any further service.

items.q: Do I need to have a clinic already?
items.a: No. This consultation is open to doctors planning their first clinic as well as existing clinic owners considering another branch.

items.q: I'm only thinking about opening a clinic. Can I still book?
items.a: Absolutely. Speaking to someone before committing to premises or investment can help you understand the process and make better-informed decisions.

items.q: Can I discuss my proposed clinic business structure?
items.a: Yes. We can discuss general considerations around company structures, partnerships and business setup. Formal company secretarial, legal and tax advice should be obtained from the relevant professionals.
Yes. Your consultation will be conducted online. Booking details and the meeting link will be provided after confirmation.

items.q: Will you help me open my clinic?
items.a: The initial session is a consultation to understand your plans, discuss your challenges and explore possible next steps. Any further assistance or services can be discussed separately.
